ranked.headline: Bias-aware and topology-based methods sharpen cell-resolved tissue architecture mapping
ranked.summary: Recent methods address size bias, neighborhood topology, and slice alignment to interpret cell organization in tissues.

ranked.headline: Posterior inference sharpens genetic and regulatory effect detection
ranked.summary: Population-scale reporter assays, trio designs, and GWAS colocalisation now feed Bayesian and genome-wide models that report posterior support.

ranked.headline: Simulation maps binding pathways and folding landscapes beyond static protein structures
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs replica-exchange, Markov-model, and AI-driven sampling with free energy methods to resolve binding and folding pathways.

ranked.headline: Network inference on paired omics data prioritizes candidate regulators and functions
ranked.summary: Six new preprints pair multi-omic or network data with interpretable inference for protein function, regulatory metabolites, and microbiome shifts.

ranked.headline: Biological structure is being encoded directly into single-cell representation objectives
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair text-aligned conditioning, Dirichlet priors and flow matching with single-cell generative and autoencoder models.

ranked.headline: Computational tools mine microbial genomes for defense systems and dark protein families
ranked.summary: Protein language models now applied across prokaryotic genomes and metagenomes reveal defense systems and uncharacterized protein families at scale.

ranked.headline: Read-level DNA methylation calling from long-read and amplicon sequencing data
ranked.summary: Long-read platforms now enable methylation calls on individual reads, prompting new pipelines for metagenomes, promoters and phased amplicons.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level and pangenome assemblies reveal plant karyotype and trait evolution
ranked.summary: Haplotype-resolved and pangenome assemblies now support both evolutionary inference and functional validation of variants and traits in plants.

ranked.headline: Portable workflow engines and AnnData tooling target reproducible omics analysis
ranked.summary: Omics datasets now routinely exceed system memory, so data access and workflow portability are becoming the limiting factors for reproducible analysis.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models couple explicit physical rules to spatial cell readouts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair calibrated mechanistic simulations with measured spatial structure in tissues, tumoroids, and immune communities.

ranked.headline: Learned predictors coupled to experimental data and physical constraints
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair AlphaFold, language models and curated PDB data with restraints to refine structure and binding predictions.

ranked.headline: Models reconstruct single-cell state trajectories from snapshot, latent, and imaging data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one publication extend snapshot single-cell data toward trajectory, communication, and morphodynamic state inference.

ranked.headline: Long-read sequencing resolves haplotype, isoform, and population-scale genome variation
ranked.summary: Long-read data now yield haplotype-resolved references and isoform catalogs that reduce short-read quantification uncertainty.

ranked.headline: Proteome-scale AlphaFold models extend to homo- and heterodimers with domain annotation
ranked.summary: Predicted dimers now span 4,777 proteomes, and domain classification reaches Swiss-Prot AlphaFold predictions, enabling assembly-level structural analysis.

ranked.headline: Faster, modular tools for sequencing QC, demultiplexing, binning and fungal profiling
ranked.summary: New preprints target throughput and deployment bottlenecks in sequencing preprocessing, metagenomic binning, and fungal ITS abundance profiling.

ranked.headline: Read-level computational tools recover microbial abundance from diverse sequencing data
ranked.summary: Existing sequencing resources, from repurposed human WGS to wastewater reads, are now being mined with open tools for microbial profiling.

ranked.headline: Deep learning links spatial transcriptomics, histology, protein imaging, and proteomics
ranked.summary: Foundation and deep models now integrate spatial transcriptomics, histology, proteomics, and microscopy for prediction and discovery.

ranked.headline: Deep sequence models predict regulatory activity and cell-type enhancers from raw DNA
ranked.summary: Sequence-based deep learning now links raw DNA to regulatory activity across reporter assays, scATAC-seq, and multi-omics profiling.

ranked.headline: Protein language and structure models extend to binding, disorder, and peptide design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published study apply pLM embeddings and structure-aware encoders to interaction, disorder, and design endpoints.

ranked.headline: Flux sampling and multiobjective ensembles for genome-scale metabolic model analysis
ranked.summary: Preprints now pair flux sampling and ensemble parameter estimation with constraint-based genome-scale metabolic models.

ranked.headline: K-mer indexes and occurrence statistics now operate directly on raw sequencing reads
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply k-mer methods to raw reads for phylogenetics, genome profiling, pangenome genotyping, and barcode correction.

ranked.headline: Graph and knowledge-based models score protein binding, pose, and metal sites
ranked.summary: Newly published tools extend graph neural networks and knowledge-based scoring to ligand affinity, docking, carbohydrate complexes, and metal sites.

ranked.headline: Cortical network stability and complexity via energy and recurrence measures
ranked.summary: Energy landscapes, interpretable EEG features, and recurrence and dimensionality metrics now quantify stability and complexity of cortical state.

ranked.headline: Learned representations replace sequence comparison in homology search and annotation
ranked.summary: Recent tools pair LLM embeddings, structural tokens, and supervised models with homology search, annotation, and alignment filtering.

ranked.headline: Clinical and downstream utility now benchmark variant and genomic inference methods
ranked.summary: Evaluation is shifting from internal fit toward downstream clinical and polygenic risk consequences of variant and genomic tools.

ranked.headline: Metagenome-mined RNA-guided nucleases with broad PAMs; genome-wide off-target profiling
ranked.summary: Structure-led metagenome search and genome-wide off-target profiling now address both nuclease discovery and specificity assessment.

ranked.headline: Pretrained vision models targeting robustness to acquisition shift in biomedical imaging
ranked.summary: Parameter-efficient and shift-robust pretrained models now target microscopy, flow cytometry, calcium imaging, and cell painting data.

ranked.headline: Flow-based and operator-theoretic models of biological network dynamics across scales
ranked.summary: Recent work frames biological dynamics as network flows or linear operators, opening counterfactual and intervention analyses.

ranked.headline: MD simulations and docking guide design of peptides, antibodies, and siRNAs
ranked.summary: Computational pipelines combining AlphaFold2, docking, and MD now constrain predicted complexes across therapeutic and receptor targets.

ranked.headline: Representation and topology choices shape inferred protein conformational organization
ranked.summary: Recent MD and PDB-scale preprints show that analysis choices, not only trajectories, determine inferred conformational states and transitions.

ranked.headline: Transformers and benchmarks advance genotype imputation and causal genetic inference
ranked.summary: Imputation, genomic prediction, and multi-ancestry Mendelian randomization are now benchmarked on large genotype datasets.

ranked.headline: Structured biological priors paired with learned models map evidence to mechanism
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a peer-reviewed study pair curated biological structure with deep learning to predict drug responses, side effects and modes of action.

ranked.headline: Physics-based reweighting equilibrates AI-generated protein structure ensembles
ranked.summary: Physics-based sampling and reweighting now reconcile divergent AI ensembles, while ML potentials and GPU MD methods extend computational scale.

ranked.headline: Quantitative models link influenza immunity, viral kinetics, and serology prediction
ranked.summary: Recent modeling work predicts influenza severity, rapid test performance, and serological measurements across cohorts from within-host to population scales.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level assemblies drive demographic, comparative and sex-linkage inference
ranked.summary: Recent chromosome-level assemblies in marsupials, spiders and single-genome tools extend genome resources to population history and assembly curation.

ranked.headline: Inferring minority and somatic genotypes across bulk, single-cell and cell-free sequencing
ranked.summary: Tools now target minority-genotype and non-germline signal, with reference choice and error modelling central to accuracy.

ranked.headline: Self-contained tools unify drift correction, tracking, and detection in microscopy
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications release open-source tools covering drift, segmentation, tracking, and lineage for quantitative live imaging.

ranked.headline: Bayesian phylogenetics reconstructs cell lineages, migration routes, and timing
ranked.summary: Lineage-tracing data now support joint Bayesian estimation of tree topology, migration, and timing, with new checks on prior assumptions.

ranked.headline: Protein language models reshape decoy design, enzyme annotation, and database search
ranked.summary: Benchmarks now test learned protein sequence models against BLAST, reversal decoys, and classical database search in proteomics.

ranked.headline: Machine learning methods detect selective sweeps and infer origin from genetic data
ranked.summary: Positive-unlabeled and image-based learning now extend selection scans to demographic uncertainty and pollen-based geolocation.
